archive_frequency: daily at 04:00 UTC, maximum five-minute jitter
derivative_pruning: Only deploy/reality-research.json scheduled completed example caches and unpublished builder scratch are disposable. Keep immutable manifests/code/source references and visible pruning receipts. Raw roots, accepted Gate B/C/D artifacts and protected Prometheus evidence are excluded.
offloading: Use verified archive CLI with an explicitly chosen mounted/off-host destination before the alert deadline. Never delete originals automatically. Off-host destination is not configured on this host.
rollover: A new raw root requires an intentional collector stop, finalized verified archive, retained old-root manifest, and reviewed disk commitments. Keep the original root recoverable; new root identity/ordinals must remain distinct. No automatic rollover is configured.
on_exhaustion: Fail closed, publish FAILED status if disk permits, retain complete checksummed observations, require operator capacity action. Do not drop frames or erase observations to maintain an apparently healthy state.
headroom_basis: Preflight budgets the full remaining raw allocation plus the full archive allocation while preserving 20 GiB. This is a bounded approximately 48 GiB local commitment, not all free disk.
research_priority: Collector: 512 MiB maximum, 25% of one CPU. Capacity: 128 MiB, 10% CPU. Archive: 256 MiB, 10% CPU, idle I/O and lower scheduling priority. Both operations workers are independent of collector and frontend.
limits: Local replication is not off-host redundancy.
Growth forecasts vary; the five-minute capacity monitor must remain enabled.
A retention stop or budget stop is intentional; finite local disks cannot preserve unlimited original observations.
Full archival verification and collector cold-start replay scale with archive size; bounded archival jobs may fail at their timeout and must be inspected.
